transcript.text: Hi, good evening! This is Shreya calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking with Mr. Rahul?
Yes, this is Rahul. What is this call about?
Thank you. I'm an automated assistant, and this call is recorded. Is your Mumbai Bank card the one ending in four, two, seven, one?
Yes, that's my card. But what exactly do you want to talk about?
Got it, thanks. It looks like this month's payment hasn't come through yet. Is all well?
Actually, I already paid two days ago through UPI, so I'm not sure why you're saying it hasn't come through.
